newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - May 2.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - May 2.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Australian Prime Minister John Howard offered to allow Rupert Murdoch's News Corp Ltd a higher stake in Seven Network Ltd if Murdoch would support a takeover by Kerry Packer of John Fairfax Holdings Ltd, The Australian Financial Review reported on Friday. But the plan fell apart last week when News rejected another element of the deal which would have required News sell some of its Australian newspapers, the newspaper said.
* Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$18.08 (unch)

The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd's (BHP) 3,000 Newcastle workers voted to strike for 24 hours starting immediately in protest against BHP's decision to shut down steel-making at Newcastle by 1999, a union official said on Friday.

Carpenter Pacific Resources NL on Thursday said a consulting geologists report showed enormous gold assays of more than 6,500 grams a tonne (g/t) from the Mt Kare project in Papua New Guinea could be independently validated.
